name: The Sleeping Partner
text: Every 3 turns in this slot: get two Acorns per Hedgerow unit touching this.
golden_text: Every 3 turns in this slot: get four Acorns per Hedgerow unit touching this.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Touching means the unbroken zigzag run through this, including this. Only Hedgerow folk count. Moving or tripling restarts the wait. Extra triggers do not advance it.
golden_details: Touching means the unbroken zigzag run through this, including this. Only Hedgerow folk count. Moving or tripling restarts the wait. Extra triggers do not advance it.
